definitions: To hold a grudge or resentment, often due to a past wrong or perceived injustice.
To be easily offended or quick to anger, often because of a feeling of inferiority or a desire to prove oneself.
examples: He's always had a chip on his shoulder about not getting promoted.
She seems to have a chip on her shoulder regarding her family's wealth.
Don't mention his height; he has a chip on his shoulder about it.
lemma: to have a chip on one's shoulder
synonyms: to have an axe to grind
source: to have a chip on one's shoulder
